# B05 — Complete Draft Generation (Dev Implementation)

**Status:** Detailed; follows stable B04 Deck/Preview contracts.  
**Outcome:** Generate complete multi-slide HTML draft with appropriate template/theme, sources/images, observable progress, quality controls and correct partial-result behavior.  
**Specs:** UC-001 remaining alternatives; FR-022–025, FR-028, FR-066, FR-091–093, FR-125, FR-138; BR-013–015/017–018; NFR-009; UC-003 Stop/Fail lifecycle. Check all related spec flows before coding.  
**Decisions:** [ADR-0004](../adr/0004-request-events-lifecycle.md), [0005](../adr/0005-deck-artifacts-revisions.md), [0007](../adr/0007-design-system-templates.md).

## 1. Scope

**In:** Per-slide generation, order and per-slide status, richer layout selection, source/provenance and images, publication checks, last-good revisions, Stop/failure continuation, user-visible closing summary. **Out:** follow-up scoped edit and deck Q&A (B06), custom Design System editor (B07), additional generation formats unless explicitly selected/implemented.

**Central invariant:** Every completed slide has a published immutable revision. A failed/incomplete slide is never shown as finished and never replaces an earlier good revision. A failed run **does not** delete the confirmed Outline or successful slides. The later request builds on same Deck (FR-028).

## 2. Ownership / reuse

| Owner | Contract |
|---|---|
| `packages/presentation/deck/` | One Deck per Chat, ordered slides, stable IDs, revision/publish CAS, last-good pointer, source/provenance metadata |
| `packages/presentation/design/` | Compatible layout candidates + theme translator + template assets; no model-decided hidden visual defaults |
| `packages/tools/presentation/` | Per-slide create/publish/read tools with Host authorization |
| `packages/tools/filesystem/` | Validated source/image access from B03; never writes to project folder |
| `apps/local-web/src/opencode/` | Generation skill/prompt, structured progress + fail/Stop mapping (no custom Loop) |
| `packages/host/api/`, `packages/client/runtime/` | Status/activities, deck progress/preview, closing report |

## 3. Dev tasks

### B05-IMP-01 — Multi-slide generation state

- Transform confirmed Outline into ordered planned slides; keep stable `slideId` and desired order. Mark slides pending until Host publishes each finished revision. Generation works slide-by-slide; UI updates after durable publish, not when model begins HTML text.
- Distinguish run status from slide state. Never make per-slide state depend only on a free-text model claim or event without a publication receipt.
- **Developer checks:** all planned slides in order, each finished once, duplicate event/publish no duplicate slide, UI current selection stable during updates.

### B05-IMP-02 — Template fitting, theme, quality checks

- Use B04 layout candidates by content kinds/capacity, model picks/fills candidate; only build novel layout when none fits. Carry deck's immutable theme snapshot into each generation run. Keep chosen user colors/fonts respected; reject known model-chosen out-of-theme colors/fonts per FR-092.
- Before publishing, reject **known** missing required content, unreadability and known factual faults. Model can revise its own output inside active request, but code must not silently auto-correct content that spec reserves to the model. Automated checks cannot prove every factual/visual claim correct; don't report them as guarantees.
- **Developer checks:** incompatible template layout refused, selected theme carried to all slides, failed validation never advances current revision, corrected revision publishes once.

### B05-IMP-03 — Sources, provenance and images

- Each slide's factual/provenance records reference actual user-material location or public-research result (or label general knowledge); never claim verification not performed. Source data is written when slide content is produced and remains queryable later by B06.
- Image source follows user's interview choice: attached image, generated image, or licensed public research where available. Validate allowed research image licenses BR-014 and record URL/credit. If an optional chosen image cannot be obtained, omit it and report omission; do not auto-switch selected model.
- **Developer checks:** known-source claim has correct persisted reference, tool without source does not fabricate one, image failure produces honest note, external asset invalid/blocked doesn't mutate deck/source folder.

### B05-IMP-04 — Recovery and continuation

- Stop/failure keeps every published slide revision. Unfinished changes keep last-good version. Preserve locked format, Outline, Brief, Theme snapshot and source refs. On restart, active request becomes unfinished with no auto-retry; subsequent user request continues missing slides in same Deck with no new Outline.
- Recover incomplete staging safely: do not leave DB pointer to absent/partial file; no partial overwrite of published source. Do not use a previous runtime execution's unconfirmed tool result as proof of published content.
- **Developer checks:** stop after slide 2 of 5; fail during slide 3; restart then follow-up fills 3–5; published 1–2 unchanged; failed attempted edit doesn't corrupt prior revision.

### B05-IMP-05 — Progress and closing report

- Show pending/finished slides and progress activities as they occur. After success, closing message describes contents/assumptions/placeholders/sources per slide. After Stop/fail, report finished count if known and note deck coherence not checked (FR-025); never invent count or claim facts verified without evidence.
- **Developer checks:** report derives from persisted receipts/provenance; no nonexistent slide mentioned; user stays on selected slide; live UI reconnect reconstructs progress.

## 4. Developer verification / integration

- Unit: layout compatibility, theme validation, publication version conflicts, source labels, missing-assets rule, status aggregation.
- Integration: Outline confirmed → 5 slides in order → Preview all; failure after second publish; Host restart and continue; image service unavailable; source attachment unavailable mid-run; two Chat Decks remain isolated.
- Runtime smoke: pinned CLI + real MCP publish pathway for a small multi-slide deck; show version and any provider/cost limitations in evidence.
- Run affected `node --test` including legacy `tests/deck-pipeline.test.mjs`, `tests/publish-slide.test.mjs`, `tests/deck-client.test.mjs` as references; `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm build`.

These tests are **Dev-owned unit/integration checks**; don't turn this file into a full UC test strategy or declare the tester's regression done.

## 5. Dependency / Dev Done / B06 handoff

B04 provides atomic Outline confirmation, theme/layout contract and finished slide publication; B03 provides source/provenance; B02 provides events/Stop. Multi-slide producer and UI projection can proceed in parallel behind `DeckSnapshot`/`PublishedRevision` interfaces; only the Deck owner changes publish semantics.

**Dev Done:** complete multi-slide path, source/quality/publish gates, partial failure preservation and continuation all have working integration evidence. Handoff to B06: exact published source interface, revision API, immutable IDs, provenance model and source/target scope contract.
